title: The Part of a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Exchange Difference That Goes Back as Reward Points
content:
The part of the drop that goes back as reward points rather than money is then taken off. Where the membership standing on the profile is active and the reward points redeemed against the order come to the points block or more, the value of those points at the tier's published redemption rate is taken off, because points come back as points and not as money. Where the membership standing on the profile is active and some points were redeemed against the order but fewer than the points block, half that value is taken off. In any other case nothing is taken off.

The points block is 250 points.

## What is read, and how a value is worked out

The membership read is the one standing on the customer's profile on Northbeam Circle Membership: whether it stands active and the redemption rate its tier publishes for each hundred points. The points read are the reward points redeemed against the order the returned line was bought on, taken from that membership's ledger.

The value of a number of points at that rate is that number multiplied by the rate the tier publishes for each hundred points, divided by one hundred, and rounded to the cent. What is taken off the Northbeam Returns and Restocking exchange difference is that value, or half of it.

| The membership | Reward points redeemed against the order | Amount taken off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| active | 250 or more | the value of those points at the tier's published redemption rate |
| active | more than nothing but fewer than 250 | half that value |
| active | nothing | nothing |
| not active | any number | nothing |

## Both sides of the threshold, on hypothetical inputs

Take a tier publishing 1.20 USD for each hundred points.

*A membership standing active, 640 points redeemed against the order.* Six hundred and forty is 250 or more: 640 multiplied by 1.20 USD is 768.00, divided by one hundred is 7.68 USD, and 7.68 USD is taken off.

*A membership standing active, exactly 250 points redeemed.* Two hundred and fifty is 250 or more: the value is 3.00 USD, and 3.00 USD is taken off.

*A membership standing active, 249 points redeemed.* That is more than nothing and fewer than 250, so half the value is taken off: half of 2.988 USD, rounded to the cent, is 1.49 USD.

*A membership standing active, no points redeemed against the order.* Nothing is taken off.

*A lapsed membership, 640 points redeemed against the order.* It does not stand active, so nothing is taken off.
